description: Allow the gateway web UI (served from localhost into the webview) to drive the window frame: drag, resize, minimize/maximize, close-to-tray, its own zoom level (the interface-scale setting), the system file picker an agent's directory/file config field opens to bind a host mount, and the voice output choice: list the PipeWire sinks and route lmgw's own playback streams to one (chat-voice §12.3).
